# Hi there!

I'm Eman Ibrahim, currently pursuing my MPH in Epidemiology at Columbia. 
My interests include global health, humanitarian action, and infectious disease. A big interest of mine that has nothing to do with Public Health is Soccer/Football! 

I'm also very interested in doing research on child malnutrition and food insecurity, hence my thesis.
